note: P3068: concise canonical texts for settings / maintenance actions copied into many drivers. Applied to the publish copy only when en === from (exact). Same meaning, shorter. settingValues (P3071b): dropdown labels replaced only when the option ids match the canon ids in order and every en label equals 'from'; ids/values never change.

suppress_release_after_click.from: Some remotes send 'released' after every click, which can stop an action the click just started (e.g. curtains). When enabled, 'released' is only fired after a long press. Idea credited to Adrian_Rockall's Button+ app (community.homey.app/t/89931).

to.en: Some remotes send 'released' after each click, stopping what the click started (e.g. curtains). On: 'released' only after a long press. Idea: Button+ (Adrian_Rockall).
to.fr: Certaines télécommandes envoient « relâché » après chaque clic et stoppent l'action (ex. volets). Activé : « relâché » seulement après un appui long. Idée : Button+ (Adrian_Rockall).

offline_grace_seconds.from: Delay before marking unavailable / firing disconnect flows after a brief TCP drop (pet feeders, dehumidifiers).

to.en: Wait before unavailable / disconnect flows after a brief TCP drop.
to.fr: Attente avant indisponible / flux déconnecté après une brève coupure TCP.

adaptive_brightness.from: Off by default. Dimmer-only lights only adapt when this is on.

to.en: Off by default; dimmer-only lights adapt only when on.
to.fr: Désactivé par défaut ; lampes sans teinte adaptées seulement si coché.

tuya_time_sync.from: Turn off only if the device misbehaves after a time sync (clock jumps, schedule resets).

to.en: Turn off only if the device misbehaves after a time sync.
to.fr: Désactivez seulement si l'appareil dérape après la mise à l'heure.

device_type.from: Select the type of device connected to this module. Radiator will invert the ON/OFF logic.

to.en: Device wired to this module. Radiator inverts ON/OFF.
to.fr: Appareil relié au module. Radiateur inverse MARCHE/ARRÊT.

invert_logic_manual.from: Force invert ON/OFF logic regardless of device type (advanced users only)

to.en: Force inverted ON/OFF whatever the device type (advanced).
to.fr: Forcer l'inversion MARCHE/ARRÊT quel que soit le type (avancé).

button_mode.from: Scene Mode allows single/double/long press. Dimmer Mode only supports single press. Auto tries to detect and switch automatically.

to.en: Scene: single/double/long press. Dimmer: single only. Auto detects.
to.fr: Scène : appui simple/double/long. Variateur : simple seul. Auto détecte.

command_gap_ms.from: Minimum gap between two LAN commands. Helps firmware that silently drops rapid SETs (protocol 3.4/3.5).

to.en: Min. gap between LAN commands (3.4/3.5 firmware may drop rapid SETs).
to.fr: Écart min. entre commandes LAN (SET rapides perdus en 3.4/3.5).

adaptive_lighting.from: On by default. Nothing changes until the light is next switched on; a manual change pauses it for 60 min. Untick to disable for this light (global switch: app settings).

to.en: On by default; applies at next switch-on, a manual change pauses it 60 min. Untick to disable here (global: app settings).
to.fr: Actif par défaut ; s'applique au prochain allumage, un réglage manuel le suspend 60 min. Décochez pour l'exclure (global : réglages de l'app).

zcl_cluster_layer.from: Extra command capture, bounded bindings and reporting fallback on top of the native setup. Turn off if this device misbehaves.

to.en: Extra command capture, bindings and report fallback. Untick if it misbehaves.
to.fr: Capture, liaisons et relève de secours. Décochez en cas de souci.

battery_type.from: Select battery type manually or use auto-detection based on voltage

to.en: Manual choice, or Auto (from voltage)
to.fr: Choix manuel, ou Auto (selon la tension)

power_source.from: Select power source manually or use auto-detection

to.en: Manual choice, or Auto-detect
to.fr: Choix manuel, ou détection auto

optimization_mode.from: Balance between responsiveness and battery life

to.en: Responsiveness vs battery life
to.fr: Réactivité vs autonomie

enable_power_estimation.from: Estimate power consumption when real measurement is not available (AC/DC devices only)

to.en: Estimate power when not measured (AC/DC only)
to.fr: Estimer la puissance si non mesurée (AC/DC)

battery_critical_threshold.from: Trigger critical battery warning when below this percentage

to.en: Critical battery alert below this %
to.fr: Alerte batterie critique sous ce %

battery_low_threshold.from: Trigger low battery warning when below this percentage

to.en: Low battery alert below this %
to.fr: Alerte batterie faible sous ce %

battery_report_interval.from: How often to request battery status updates

to.en: Battery status request interval
to.fr: Intervalle de lecture batterie

enable_battery_notifications.from: Send flow notifications for battery events

to.en: Flow notifications for battery events
to.fr: Notifications Flow batterie

to.fr: Rapport de support (GitHub)

to.en: Re-bind & reporting
to.fr: Re-lier et rapports

to.fr: Tuya Revive (récupération)
